title: Funding across entities with transfer constraints
prompt: ParentP, subsidiaryA and subsidiaryB open with cash[5,8,2] USD million. A andB must pay[2,8] at10:00; P pays6 at11:00. External funding F is available only to P at09:00. At09:00 P may transfer toB and A may transfer at most1 toB. A may additionally transfer at most3 toP, arriving10:30. No other transfers, borrowing or netting are allowed; balances cannot be negative at any time. All transfer amounts and F are integer millions. F and P-to-B each range0..10; A-to-P0..3; A-to-B0..1: this is the entire menu. Minimize F, then lexicographically [A-to-P,A-to-B,P-to-B]. Report F, those three transfers, ending idle cash atA, and the naive deficit from globally pooling all opening cash against all calls.
instructions: Solve the synthetic quantitative-finance question using its supplied inputs and conventions. A calculator or local code is allowed. External market data is unnecessary.
